review_candidates.description: Position Overview The Infrastructure & IT Operations Manager I leads enterprise infrastructure and technology operations, ensuring reliable, secure delivery of server, endpoint, virtual desktop, voice/telephony, and infrastructure automation services. The Manager leads incident response and service restoration, coordinates infrastructure projects and maintenance, and partners with Network Administrators, Help Desk, IT Development, Information Security, application teams, main-office support groups, vendors, and end users. The position supports Bank and Securities entities, including Trading Floor operations , and is responsible for configuration management, change control, technical standards, documentation, operational procedures, and Disaster Recovery readiness. Ensure enterprise infrastructure services remain available, stable, secure, and within established service expectations . Manage enterprise VoIP and telephony , including Cisco Unified Communications / CallManager and IPC Unigy voice/trading platforms and endpoints. Manage enterprise VDI , including Nutanix / VMware Horizon or comparable platforms, covering availability, performance, capacity, image management, upgrades, and end-user experience. Administer Microsoft SCCM/MECM for endpoint configuration, software distribution, operating-system deployment, patching, collections, reporting, compliance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management. Develop and maintain Microsoft System Center Orchestrator (SCORCH) runbooks, integrations, and workflow automation for provisioning, service requests, repetitive tasks, and operational remediation. Maintain infrastructure security controls, including permissions, accounts, open ports, antivirus/EDR, patching, hardening, backups, audit logging, and production controls. Monitor system, application, voice, VDI, and infrastructure logs and proactively identify potential service-impacting issues. Install, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and manage lifecycle replacement of enterprise hardware and software. Maintain Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Windows Server, Windows workstations , and related Microsoft infrastructure services. Maintain configuration management and change control across infrastructure, virtualization, voice, VDI, endpoint, and automation platforms. Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, problem management, and corrective/preventive actions. Monitor performance, capacity, reliability, and resiliency and provide operational and management reporting. Research and recommend infrastructure products, services, standards, automation opportunities, and technology refresh initiatives. Develop and maintain policies, procedures, diagrams, technical standards, operational runbooks, training plans, and Disaster Recovery documentation. Coordinate incidents, service restoration, maintenance, upgrades, migrations, patch cycles, and projects with internal teams and vendors. Support infrastructure asset management, licensing, support contracts, budgeting, capacity planning, vendor management, and technology roadmaps. Provide clear technical and management communication during incidents, changes, projects, audits, and stakeholder reviews. Technology Environment Microsoft: Windows Server 2016, 2019 and above; Windows 10 & 11 Workstation and above; Active Directory; DNS; Group Policy; Logon Scripts; DHCP; MS Cluster; MS Print Server; MS SQL Server; MS IIS Server; MS Office / Microsoft 365; MS Terminal Services / Remote Desktop Services; MS SCSM; MS SCOM; MS SCCM / Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM); MS System Center Orchestrator (SCORCH), including runbooks, workflow automation, integrations, and infrastructure task automation. Virtualization, Storage & Recovery: VEEAM backup and recovery; VMware SRM; VMware ESXi / vCenter; NetApp Data Storage; Nutanix / VMware Horizon VDI. Voice & Communications: Cisco Unified Communications / CallManager and associated VoIP services and endpoints; IPC Unigy PBX / IPC voice and trading communication platforms; ASC Voice Recording or comparable voice-recording solutions; Cisco Video Conferencing Equipment. Financial & Trading: Bloomberg; LSEG (Refinitiv/Reuters) services and Trading Floor applications; various in-house, Trading Floor, and Internet applications. Qualifications Required Experience 10+ years of hands-on enterprise infrastructure, systems, network, voice, or IT operations experience with progressive responsibility. Experience leading technical staff, coordinating operational priorities, managing escalations, and delivering infrastructure projects or services. Strong hands-on experience with enterprise telephony and VoIP, including Cisco Unified Communications / CallManager and IPC Unigy or related IPC voice platforms. Trading Floor voice experience strongly preferred. Strong enterprise VDI experience, preferably Nutanix / VMware Horizon , including performance, capacity, image, profile, endpoint, and availability troubleshooting. Strong SCCM/MECM experience, including software deployment, patching, collections, endpoint configuration, reporting, and troubleshooting. Hands-on Microsoft System Center Orchestrator experience, including runbooks, integrations, and automated infrastructure workflows. Proven experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, virtualization, networking, monitoring, backup/recovery, and infrastructure security controls . Experience supporting highly available production environments. Financial services, securities, or Trading Floor experience preferred. Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident-management, and problem-resolution skills. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required. Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, ITIL, or infrastructure certifications preferred. Technical & Professional Skills Strong knowledge of Microsoft operating systems, applications, and infrastructure services, including Windows Server, Windows workstation, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, SCCM/MECM, and System Center Orchestrator . Strong technical knowledge of Cisco VoIP / Unified Communications and IPC voice technologies , including call routing, endpoints, voice services, troubleshooting, and vendor escalation. Strong working knowledge of VDI , including hypervisors, brokers, images, profiles, storage, network dependencies, capacity, and end-user performance. Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP , and enterprise network troubleshooting. Hands-on hardware and software troubleshooting experience, including leadership during high-priority production incidents. Experience with automation and scripting; PowerShell strongly preferred in addition to System Center Orchestrator. Ability to develop and maintain policies, procedures, diagrams, operational runbooks, standards, training plans, and Disaster Recovery documentation. Strong project execution, prioritization, vendor-management, and change-management skills. Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills with technical and non-technical users, management, vendors, and business stakeholders. Detail-oriented, flexible, self-motivated, customer-focused, and able to respond effectively to crises while maintaining sound judgment and technical discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment. Market and organizational factors are also considered. review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer (Level II)
review_candidates.description: Level II Systems Engineer  Escalations, Windows Server & Networking  |  Protek-IT  |  Chicago, IL (Hybrid)  |  $80K – $100K   Are you the tech who gets handed the tickets L1 couldn't close, and actually enjoys it? Join Protek-IT as our Level II Systems Engineer: the escalation point for our service desk, remote and onsite, across 100+ client environments. You'll work on Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Hyper-V, networking, and line-of-business application problems, handle hands-on project work, and be the technical voice when a client needs to understand what's going on.   About the Role   You take escalations from our L1 technicians and resolve them, remotely first and on-site when needed. You also execute Level II technical tasks on client projects (server and hypervisor replacements, network upgrades, office moves), scope new work for our account manager, and join client technical reviews as the technical voice.   This is not a help desk, people-management, or project management role. Our team lead coaches L1, and our dedicated project manager owns project planning, schedules, and budgets. Your job is to execute the technical work, do it right, and flag risks early.   Time split: ~30% escalations and troubleshooting, ~30% project tasks assigned by the PM, ~20% scoping and assessments, ~20% client technical reviews, and the rest on documentation and internal improvements. Onsite client work is about 20% of your time.   What You'll Do   Own escalated tickets from L1 and drive them to resolution; find the root cause and document the fix so L1 can handle it next time   Troubleshoot Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, Hyper-V hosts and VMs, and Microsoft 365 mail flow and identity issues   Diagnose firewall, VPN, switching, VLAN, and Wi-Fi problems; fix configuration and recommend redesign where needed   Troubleshoot line-of-business applications (e.g., ERP, Sage, QuickBooks, UPS WorldShip, document management etc.) at the server, database, and client level, including upgrades   Handle vendor escalations and coordination: open and own cases with software vendors, ISPs, carriers, and hardware manufacturers until resolved, keeping the client and team updated   Execute Level II project tasks (staging, configuration, cutover, documentation) from the PM's plan; occasional scheduled evening cutovers   Scope client and prospect requests, including site visits, and hand the account manager a clear scope, bill of materials, and labor estimate   Join the account manager in client technical reviews: environment health, risks, lifecycle replacements, and next steps   Keep client documentation current in Hudu and log time accurately in HaloPSA   What We're Looking For   Required:   3+ years handling Level II escalations in an MSP or multi-client environment, both remote and onsite   Strong Windows Server administration: Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, Group Policy, file and print   Hands-on Hyper-V experience: host and VM management, storage, and troubleshooting (Azure a plus)   Advanced networking: VLANs, routing, firewalls (SonicWall, UniFi, or similar), site-to-site and client VPN, switching, Wi-Fi   Solid Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration: mailboxes, mail flow, MFA, conditional access basics   Experience troubleshooting line-of-business applications and working with vendor support   Clear communication with non-technical clients, and disciplined documentation and time-logging habits   Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (client sites across Chicagoland)   Nice to Have:   Intune/Autopilot, backup and disaster recovery, or PowerShell scripting   Experience with HaloPSA, N-central, Hudu, CIPP, Action1, ConnectSecure, UniFi, or 3CX   Scoping work, building BOMs, or joining client technical reviews (TBRs/QBRs)   Compliance experience: CIS, NIST, HIPAA, PCI, SOC 2, or CMMC readiness, audit support, or cyber-insurance and vendor security questionnaires   Certifications such as Network+, MS-102, AZ-104, or Security+   Compensation & Benefits   $80,000 – $100,000 base salary, depending on experience   100% paid Blue Cross Blue Shield healthcare (after 30 days)   401(k) with 4% company match (after first year)   Unlimited PTO based on performance and coverage   Professional development assistance and mileage reimbursement for client travel   Schedule & Location: Monday – Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM. Office at 5019 W Lawrence Ave, Chicago, plus client sites; flexible remote work as results allow.   About Protek-IT   Protek-IT is a managed service provider (MSP) delivering efficient, personalized IT support to 100+ small businesses and non-profits across Chicagoland, including non-profits, labor unions, construction, property management, manufacturing, legal, and professional services. We're a tight team of 10 that goes above and beyond, communicates directly, and has each other's backs.   Interview process: A 30-minute call with the owner, a technical interview with our team, an in-person meeting at our office, and a hands-on troubleshooting session on a real (anonymized) escalation scenario.
